pros: Securely manages organizational passwords with strong features.
Cost-effective solution for team-based password management.
Excellent cross-platform compatibility and browser integration.
cons: Mobile application interface could be more refined.
Autofill functionality occasionally requires manual adjustment.
Team management and personal vault experiences are somewhat siloed.
changed: Con 3: 'Initial setup for advanced team features might have a slight learning curve' was replaced by 'Team management and personal vault experiences are somewhat siloed' because the note '[friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed' indicates a more persistent structural separation rather than just an initial learning curve.
